blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years ago, expounded by me, granny.
blocks.directed: [long pause] Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years ago, expounded by me, granny.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: For the duration of this humorous exposition, I will be taking on the role of Abhinavagupta.
blocks.directed: For the duration of this humorous exposition, I will be taking on the role of Abhinavagupta.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The Essence of Tantra: or, why you’re literally Śiva and somehow haven’t clocked it yet.
blocks.directed: The Essence of Tantra: or, why you’re literally Śiva and somehow haven’t clocked it yet.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Alright, listen up.
blocks.directed: Alright, listen up.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: I’ve written this absolutely massive book called the Tantrāloka. Proper monster of a text. Not everyone’s got the time or mental bandwidth to get through it.
blocks.directed: I’ve written this absolutely massive book called the Tantrāloka. Proper monster of a text. Not everyone’s got the time or mental bandwidth to get through it.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: So here’s the Tantrasāra. Same essential teaching, less messing about.
blocks.directed: So here’s the Tantrasāra. Same essential teaching, less messing about.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: First, massive respect to the divine Mother and Father, Śakti and Śiva. And to my teacher Śambhunātha, whose wisdom opened my heart like a lotus.
blocks.directed: First, massive respect to the divine Mother and Father, Śakti and Śiva. And to my teacher Śambhunātha, whose wisdom opened my heart like a lotus.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Right. Let’s get into it.
blocks.directed: Right. Let’s get into it.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text:
विमलकलाश्रयाभिनवसृष्टिमहा जननी भरिततनुश् च पञ्चमुखगुप्तरुचिर् जनकः
तदुभययामलस्फुरितभावविसर्गमयं हृदयम् अनुत्तरामृतकुलं मम संस्फुरतात्
blocks.directed:
[slowly] विमलकलाश्रयाभिनवसृष्टिमहा जननी भरिततनुश् च पञ्चमुखगुप्तरुचिर् जनकः
तदुभययामलस्फुरितभावविसर्गमयं हृदयम् अनुत्तरामृतकुलं मम संस्फुरतात्

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text:
विततस् तन्त्रालोको विगाहितुं नैव शक्यते सर्वैः
ऋजुवचनविरचितम् इदं तु तन्त्रसारं ततः शृणुत
blocks.directed:
[slowly] विततस् तन्त्रालोको विगाहितुं नैव शक्यते सर्वैः
ऋजुवचनविरचितम् इदं तु तन्त्रसारं ततः शृणुत

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text:
श्रीशम्भुनाथभास्करचरणनिपातप्रभापगतसंकोचम्
अभिनवगुप्तहृदम्बुजम् एतद् विचिनुत महेशपूजनहेतोः
blocks.directed:
[slowly] श्रीशम्भुनाथभास्करचरणनिपातप्रभापगतसंकोचम्
अभिनवगुप्तहृदम्बुजम् एतद् विचिनुत महेशपूजनहेतोः

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Here’s the situation.
blocks.directed: Here’s the situation.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: You’re bound because you’re ignorant.
blocks.directed: You’re bound because you’re ignorant.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And you’re liberated through knowledge.
blocks.directed: And you’re liberated through knowledge.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Simple as that.
blocks.directed: Simple as that.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: But before you go thinking I’m talking about reading a few books and becoming some enlightened intellectual, absolutely not.
blocks.directed: But before you go thinking I’m talking about reading a few books and becoming some enlightened intellectual, absolutely not.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: There are actually two kinds of ignorance.
blocks.directed: There are actually two kinds of ignorance.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The first is bauddha-ajñāna.
blocks.directed: The first is bauddha-ajñāna.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: That’s when your understanding is all over the place. You don’t know what’s real, or worse, you’re completely convinced of something that’s wrong.
blocks.directed: That’s when your understanding is all over the place. You don’t know what’s real, or worse, you’re completely convinced of something that’s wrong.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: You genuinely believe you’re just this separate little individual knocking about in a universe full of other separate things.
blocks.directed: You genuinely believe you’re just this separate little individual knocking about in a universe full of other separate things.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The second is pauruṣa-ajñāna.
blocks.directed: The second is pauruṣa-ajñāna.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Now this one’s deeper.
blocks.directed: Now this one’s deeper.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: This isn’t just having the wrong ideas. It’s the actual condition of experiencing yourself as a limited being.
blocks.directed: This isn’t just having the wrong ideas. It’s the actual condition of experiencing yourself as a limited being.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Consciousness itself has contracted.
blocks.directed: Consciousness itself has contracted.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Saṃkoca.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Saṃkoca.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The infinite has somehow started experiencing itself as finite.
blocks.directed: The infinite has somehow started experiencing itself as finite.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Absolutely mental, when you think about it.
blocks.directed: Absolutely mental, when you think about it.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And this contracted condition is the root of saṃsāra.
blocks.directed: And this contracted condition is the root of saṃsāra.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Now, initiation — dīkṣā — can remove that deeper ignorance.
blocks.directed: Now, initiation — dīkṣā — can remove that deeper ignorance.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: But here’s the thing.
blocks.directed: But here’s the thing.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: You can’t just abandon understanding and expect everything to sort itself out.
blocks.directed: You can’t just abandon understanding and expect everything to sort itself out.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: You need proper discernment. You need to understand what you’re doing, what you’re seeking, and what needs to be abandoned.
blocks.directed: You need proper discernment. You need to understand what you’re doing, what you’re seeking, and what needs to be abandoned.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And if you cultivate that understanding correctly, something remarkable happens.
blocks.directed: And if you cultivate that understanding correctly, something remarkable happens.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Your conceptual knowledge gradually takes you beyond conceptual knowledge.
blocks.directed: Your conceptual knowledge gradually takes you beyond conceptual knowledge.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: You use thought to get beyond thought.
blocks.directed: You use thought to get beyond thought.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Not because thinking is evil, but because correct thinking can dismantle the very misconceptions keeping consciousness contracted.
blocks.directed: Not because thinking is evil, but because correct thinking can dismantle the very misconceptions keeping consciousness contracted.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The destination isn’t a better concept of Śiva. It’s the recognition of your own nature as Śiva.
blocks.directed: The destination isn’t a better concept of Śiva. It’s the recognition of your own nature as Śiva.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And that’s what we’re doing here.
blocks.directed: And that’s what we’re doing here.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Now, you might be wondering what exactly you’re supposed to recognise.
blocks.directed: Now, you might be wondering what exactly you’re supposed to recognise.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Good question.
blocks.directed: Good question.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Let’s talk about reality.
blocks.directed: Let’s talk about reality.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Look around you.
blocks.directed: Look around you.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Everything you see, hear, feel, remember, imagine — absolutely everything that appears — appears through prakāśa.
blocks.directed: Everything you see, hear, feel, remember, imagine — absolutely everything that appears — appears through prakāśa.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The light of consciousness.
blocks.directed: The light of consciousness.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And no, mate, I don’t mean sunlight.
blocks.directed: And no, mate, I don’t mean sunlight.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: I mean the very fact that anything can manifest, can be known, can appear at all.
blocks.directed: I mean the very fact that anything can manifest, can be known, can appear at all.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Try finding something outside the possibility of awareness.
blocks.directed: Try finding something outside the possibility of awareness.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Go on.
blocks.directed: Go on.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: I’ll wait.
blocks.directed: I’ll wait.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: You can’t.
blocks.directed: You can’t.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Even space and time, the things you imagine containing everything else, are themselves manifested in awareness.
blocks.directed: Even space and time, the things you imagine containing everything else, are themselves manifested in awareness.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: So consciousness isn’t some little thing sitting inside your head, looking out at a universe.
blocks.directed: So consciousness isn’t some little thing sitting inside your head, looking out at a universe.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: It’s the very luminosity through which the universe appears.
blocks.directed: It’s the very luminosity through which the universe appears.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And here’s where it gets interesting.
blocks.directed: And here’s where it gets interesting.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Consciousness doesn’t need another consciousness to illuminate it.
blocks.directed: Consciousness doesn’t need another consciousness to illuminate it.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Because then you’d need another one to illuminate that one.
blocks.directed: Because then you’d need another one to illuminate that one.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And another.
blocks.directed: And another.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And another.
blocks.directed: And another.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Congratulations, you’ve invented an infinite regress.
blocks.directed: Congratulations, you’ve invented an infinite regress.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: No thanks.
blocks.directed: No thanks.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Consciousness is self-luminous.
blocks.directed: Consciousness is self-luminous.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: It doesn’t borrow its light from something else.
blocks.directed: It doesn’t borrow its light from something else.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: It is svatantra — independent, sovereign, free.
blocks.directed: It is svatantra — independent, sovereign, free.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And that freedom?
blocks.directed: And that freedom?

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Svātantrya.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Svātantrya.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: That’s the whole game.
blocks.directed: That’s the whole game.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Śiva is not some bloke sitting above the clouds deciding what happens next.
blocks.directed: Śiva is not some bloke sitting above the clouds deciding what happens next.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Śiva is this absolutely unrestricted, self-aware luminosity.
blocks.directed: Śiva is this absolutely unrestricted, self-aware luminosity.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And because he’s free, he can manifest in every conceivable form without ceasing to be himself.
blocks.directed: And because he’s free, he can manifest in every conceivable form without ceasing to be himself.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Now, that freedom expresses itself through five great powers.
blocks.directed: Now, that freedom expresses itself through five great powers.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: You’ve got cit-śakti, the power of consciousness itself.
blocks.directed: You’ve got cit-śakti, the power of consciousness itself.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Ānanda-śakti, the bliss of being utterly free and complete.
blocks.directed: Ānanda-śakti, the bliss of being utterly free and complete.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Icchā-śakti, the power of will.
blocks.directed: Icchā-śakti, the power of will.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Jñāna-śakti, the power of knowing.
blocks.directed: Jñāna-śakti, the power of knowing.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And kriyā-śakti, the power of action.
blocks.directed: And kriyā-śakti, the power of action.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Don’t imagine five different substances.
blocks.directed: Don’t imagine five different substances.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: It’s the same Śiva, considered through different aspects of his own freedom.
blocks.directed: It’s the same Śiva, considered through different aspects of his own freedom.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And now comes the really ridiculous part.
blocks.directed: And now comes the really ridiculous part.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: This utterly unlimited consciousness, resting in its own bliss, can freely manifest itself as limited.
blocks.directed: This utterly unlimited consciousness, resting in its own bliss, can freely manifest itself as limited.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The infinite appears as the tiny individual.
blocks.directed: The infinite appears as the tiny individual.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Aṇu.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Aṇu.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: That’s you.
blocks.directed: That’s you.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Not because something outside Śiva has trapped him.
blocks.directed: Not because something outside Śiva has trapped him.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: There’s nothing outside Śiva capable of doing that.
blocks.directed: There’s nothing outside Śiva capable of doing that.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: It’s his own freedom.
blocks.directed: It’s his own freedom.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The very power through which consciousness manifests the entire universe also makes possible the appearance of limitation.
blocks.directed: The very power through which consciousness manifests the entire universe also makes possible the appearance of limitation.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: So what happens when that limitation is lifted?
blocks.directed: So what happens when that limitation is lifted?

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Śiva recognises himself.
blocks.directed: Śiva recognises himself.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The same consciousness that appeared contracted shines again in its unrestricted nature.
blocks.directed: The same consciousness that appeared contracted shines again in its unrestricted nature.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And because beings experience this recognition differently, there are different approaches.
blocks.directed: And because beings experience this recognition differently, there are different approaches.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Some don’t require a method at all.
blocks.directed: Some don’t require a method at all.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: That’s anupāya.
blocks.directed: That’s anupāya.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Others recognise through the power of will, through pure awareness and immediate orientation.
blocks.directed: Others recognise through the power of will, through pure awareness and immediate orientation.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: That’s śāmbhavopāya.
blocks.directed: That’s śāmbhavopāya.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Others work through refined understanding and contemplation.
blocks.directed: Others work through refined understanding and contemplation.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: That’s śāktopāya.
blocks.directed: That’s śāktopāya.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And others work through embodied practices, breath, concentration, and activity.
blocks.directed: And others work through embodied practices, breath, concentration, and activity.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: That’s āṇavopāya.
blocks.directed: That’s āṇavopāya.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Four possibilities.
blocks.directed: Four possibilities.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: One reality.
blocks.directed: One reality.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: And I’m going to explain each of them.
blocks.directed: And I’m going to explain each of them.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: But understand this before we go any further.
blocks.directed: But understand this before we go any further.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: You are not trying to manufacture Śiva.
blocks.directed: You are not trying to manufacture Śiva.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: You are not trying to construct some new divine identity.
blocks.directed: You are not trying to construct some new divine identity.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The reality you’re seeking is already the nature of the very consciousness by which you’re seeking it.
blocks.directed: The reality you’re seeking is already the nature of the very consciousness by which you’re seeking it.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The apparent limitation and its removal both occur through Śiva’s own freedom.
blocks.directed: The apparent limitation and its removal both occur through Śiva’s own freedom.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: The entire spiritual journey is Śiva appearing to forget himself, and Śiva recognising himself again.
blocks.directed: The entire spiritual journey is Śiva appearing to forget himself, and Śiva recognising himself again.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: Right.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Right.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: On to the methods.
blocks.directed: On to the methods.

blocks.section: Tantrasara, written by Abhinavagupta circa a thousand years
blocks.text: This is a creative, slang-language retelling of Chapter 1, not Abhinavagupta’s exact words. It follows the Sanskrit text’s treatment of ignorance, liberating knowledge, prakāśa, svātantrya, the five śaktis and the four upāyas.
blocks.directed: This is a creative, slang-language retelling of Chapter 1, not Abhinavagupta’s exact words. It follows the Sanskrit text’s treatment of ignorance, liberating knowledge, prakāśa, svātantrya, the five śaktis and the four upāyas.
